business_summary.text: Ceinsys Tech Limited is a leading technology solution provider in the IT-enabled sector, specializing in engineering and technology solutions in the infrastructure domain, with expertise in geospatial intelligence and AI/ML-enabled applications.

call_points.text: Management expects growth momentum to continue at a similar rate as the past 58% CAGR without providing specific FY27 numbers.
Targeting to invest ₹12-15 Cr in developing 3 major IPs in the current year.
EBITDA margin expansion driven by higher-value solutions, skilling, and AI/ML-enabled products; margins sustainable as per management.
Mitigation plan in place to manage risks by diversifying across domains and adjusting to market demand.

guidance.statement: Growth momentum to continue at a similar rate as the past 58% CAGR
Order inflow of more than ₹350 Cr by Q2FY27
VTS subsidiary to contribute more than ₹20 Cr with positive EBITDA in FY27

industry: Information Technology > IT - Services > IT Enabled Services

operating_notes.text: ₹150 Cr of revenue comes from mobility and product solutions, which are run-rate businesses not backed by the order book.
The company has developed 2 IPs and is targeting to develop 3 more with an expenditure outlay of ₹12-15 Cr in the current year.

timeline.summary: Ceinsys Tech Limited held its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on June 3, 2026, to discuss the audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for preferential issue modification via postal ballot

watchlist.response: Management expects order inflow to exceed ₹350 Cr by Q2FY27 and surpass FY26 levels by Q3FY27, with a strong pipeline in infrastructure, transport, and energy segments.
watchlist.text: Order book has been shrinking year-on-year and order intake in FY26 was less than ₹400 Cr.

watchlist.response: The increase is due to unachieved milestones in government projects, which are expected to be billed in Q1 and Q2 of FY27; it is normal as per Ind AS accounting.
watchlist.text: Unbilled revenue has grown significantly to ₹330 Cr, raising questions about aggressive accounting.
